reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I told her I'd updated the deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form to 24 September, replacing the 20 November date from her #north-team post this morning.

**The new date may already have passed.** Today is 14 October, so if she means 24 September this year, the deadline is gone. I asked her whether she meant next September or whether the form is already signed. She hasn't answered yet.

- **Original post:** She is in #north-team, so I read it. At 09:00 she gave 20 November, and I had confirmed that date in a thread there.
- **Saved correction:** Her messages go into gbrain automatically, but I also saved the correction as a fact on Tamsin Cold Chain, linked to both her posts. That way the old 20 November date won't be what comes back when someone looks it up.
- **Sharing:** A signing deadline is an operational date, not a finance figure, so it can be shared in either channel.
- **Not changed:** My earlier reply in the #north-team thread still says 20 November. Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't post a correction there. Dana and Marcus could still read the old date in that thread, though. If Ilse wants, I can add a one-line correction.
